n = int(input())
m = int(input())
L = int(input())
R = int(input())

mod = 998244353

def power_mod(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

inv2 = power_mod(2, mod - 2, mod)
diff = R - L + 1
p1 = diff // 2
p2 = diff - p1

if (n * m) % 2 == 1:
    ans = power_mod(diff, n * m, mod)
else:
    pp1 = diff
    pp2 = abs(p1 - p2)
    opt1 = power_mod(pp1, n * m, mod)
    opt2 = power_mod(pp2, n * m, mod)
    opt = (opt1 + opt2) % mod
    ans = (opt * inv2) % mod

print(ans)
